resources.string: May your Christmas be filled with happiness, warmth, and beautiful memories. You deserve all the wonderful things this season has to offer.

I just want to remind you how much I love and appreciate you. Thank you for everything you do, for your care, and for always making our home special.\n\nI hope this Christmas brings you lots of happiness, laughter, good health, and all the things that make you smile. You deserve to be happy and spoiled, especially today!
